files.role: Creates the calendar_event_index table mapping atlas_event_id to google_event_id with lifecycle status tracking

Pydantic request and response models. Sprint03 retrofits CalendarCreateEventRequest (add atlas_event_id) and CalendarCreateEventResult (rename, add atlas_event_id, widen status). Adds CalendarUpdateEventRequest and CalendarDeleteResult.
Google Calendar API v3 client. Sprint03 adds update_event() and delete_event() and retrofits create_event() to accept atlas_event_id for extendedProperties injection.

methods.name: fetch_events
methods.purpose: Unchanged from Sprint01. Call Google Calendar events.list for the primary calendar.

methods.name: create_event
methods.purpose: Insert a new event via events.insert. Sprint03 retrofit: include atlas_event_id in extendedProperties.private in the request body. Returns CalendarEventOperationResult with status='created'.

methods.name: update_event
methods.purpose: Patch an existing Google Calendar event via events.patch. Always re-sends extendedProperties.private.atlas_event_id in the patch body. Returns CalendarEventOperationResult with status='updated'. Raises ValueError on non-2xx. Raises GoogleEventNotFoundError (a distinct ValueError subclass or sentinel) on 404 so the router can distinguish missing-event from other API failures.

methods.name: delete_event
methods.purpose: Delete a Google Calendar event via events.delete. Returns True on 204 success. Returns False on 404 (event already absent — idempotent case). Raises ValueError on other non-2xx responses.

methods.name: _normalize_event
methods.purpose: Unchanged from Sprint01. Normalize a Google Calendar event item dict into CalendarEventRow.

methods.name: _rfc3339
methods.purpose: Append Z to a datetime string if no timezone offset is present. Used by create_event and update_event for timed events.

methods.name: write_decision_log
methods.purpose: Extended in Sprint03: adds atlas_event_id parameter (nullable, default None) so update and delete log entries carry Atlas event identity even when google_event_id is unavailable (e.g., EVENT_NOT_FOUND path). Sprint02 call sites pass None implicitly. Sprint03 adds new operation values: 'calendar_event_update', 'calendar_event_delete'. Writes to calendar_decision_log; the atlas_event_id column is added by migration 004_decision_log_atlas_event_id.sql.

methods.name: get_event_index_by_atlas_id
methods.purpose: Return the calendar_event_index row for the given atlas_event_id as a dict, or None if no row exists. Returns rows of any status (active, deleted, error) — callers inspect the status field to decide behavior.

methods.name: upsert_event_index
methods.purpose: Insert a new active calendar_event_index row for the atlas_event_id + google_event_id mapping. If a row already exists with any status (deleted or error), reactivate it by updating status='active', google_event_id, calendar_id, updated_at, last_success_at=NOW(), last_error=NULL. Sets last_success_at on insert. Uses ON CONFLICT (atlas_event_id) DO UPDATE to handle the reactivation case atomically.

methods.name: mark_event_index_deleted
methods.purpose: Set status='deleted' on the calendar_event_index row for the given atlas_event_id. Updates updated_at. If note is provided, writes it to last_error for audit context (e.g., 'remote event was already absent'). Never deletes the row.

methods.name: mark_event_index_error
methods.purpose: Set status='error' on the calendar_event_index row for the given atlas_event_id. Writes error_summary to last_error. Updates updated_at. Used when PATCH finds the Google event missing remotely.

files.role: HTTP router. Sprint03 adds PATCH and DELETE handlers, updates POST handler for idempotent create, and extracts token refresh into a shared internal helper.

methods.purpose: Unchanged from Sprint01.

methods.purpose: Unchanged from Sprint01.

methods.purpose: Unchanged from Sprint01. Sprint03 refactor: uses _get_valid_access_token() helper.

methods.name: get_status
methods.purpose: Unchanged from Sprint01.

methods.name: create_event
methods.purpose: Sprint03 retrofit: implements idempotent create. Checks event index by atlas_event_id before calling Google. Returns existing event with status='existing' if active mapping found. Creates new event and writes index entry if not. INDEX_WRITE_FAILURE is a hard error. Calls _get_valid_access_token() for token management.

methods.name: update_event
methods.purpose: PATCH /api/calendar/events/{atlas_event_id}. Resolves Google event via event index. Returns EVENT_NOT_FOUND if no active index entry. Returns GOOGLE_EVENT_NOT_FOUND and sets index to 'error' if Google event missing. Returns CalendarEventOperationResult with status='updated' on success. HTTP 200.

methods.name: delete_event
methods.purpose: DELETE /api/calendar/events/{atlas_event_id}. Idempotent. Returns success if no index row, if row already deleted, or if Google returns 404. Marks index as 'deleted' on any of these cases. Writes decision log. HTTP 200.

methods.name: _get_valid_access_token
methods.purpose: Shared token refresh helper. Returns a valid access_token string on success. Returns a JSONResponse (api_error) on CALENDAR_TOKEN_EXPIRED or CALENDAR_ACCESS_REVOKED. CALL-SITE OBLIGATION: every caller must branch on isinstance(result, JSONResponse) before using the return value — if result is a JSONResponse it must be returned immediately to the caller, not passed to Google API code. Three handlers use this helper (create_event, update_event, delete_event).
